newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp Centralia starts one unit.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp Centralia starts one unit.

text.p: The 670-megawatt unit at the Centralia power plant in southwest Washington state, which tripped off-line Thursday, was restarted early Saturday morning, but the plant's other unit was shut for a similar problem Saturday afternoon, said PacifiCorp on Monday.
The unit which was shut Saturday due to a "somewhat routine" tube leak should be back up by this afternoon, said PacifiCorp spokesman Bob French.
PacifiCorp owns a 47.5 percent stake in Centralia and operates the coal-fired plant.
